Syntax
Std_ReturnType <Module>_DemRead<DataElement> (
uint8* Data,
uint16 DataLength,
Dcm_NegativeResponseCodeType* ErrorCode
)
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Parameters (in)
DataLength
Length in byte of the data to be read
Parameters (inout)
None
Data
Buffer where the requested data shall be copied to
Parameters (out)
ErrorCode
If the operation Xxx_ReadData returns value E_NOT_OK, the
Dcm module shall send a negative response with NRC code
equal to the parameter ErrorCode parameter value. This
parameter exists to ensure 1:1 interface compatibility for Dcm
and Dem SwCluC proxy interfaces enabling a common data
access. The returned error code has no meaning for the Dem
and shall be discarded.
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Request was successful.
E_NOT_OK: Request was not successful.
Description
Requests the current value of the data element. There is one separate callback per data
element, if no port interface is provided by the Dem.
